text: A verifier shall reject duplicates, unresolved/wrong-kind names, missing required initializers, mismatched initializers/operands, invalid declaration placement, and unavailable SSA inputs. Known immutable stores shall be rejected even through transparent pointer derivations. Dynamic violations shall use the defined execution faults.
